fields.description: Master switch. With this off the tools refuse to run and the button on the Interview is hidden.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The Flow Agent that reads the transcript and drafts the feedback.
fields.label: Agent

fields.description: The Manual Flow Trigger fired by the Interview form's button and by ingest_transcript.
fields.label: Trigger

fields.options: Transcripts arrive from whatever recorded the interview -- a Teams or Zoom export, a note-taker bot, a vendor API, or a recruiter pasting text into the Interview. Each row below is one place to look; they are tried top to bottom and the first row that returns text wins. Nothing here is hard-coded in the agent, so a new provider is a new row, not a code change.

fields.description: Where to look for the transcript, in order of preference.
fields.label: Sources

fields.description: A transcript shorter than this is treated as unusable -- the agent reports it and stops rather than rating a candidate off two lines of text.
fields.label: Minimum Transcript Characters

fields.description: Characters returned per read. A longer transcript comes back in windows, with a cursor to continue from.
fields.label: Maximum Characters Per Read

fields.description: Rating scale used when an Interview Type's Expected Skill Set row leaves it blank. Never 0: the obtained-score calculation on Interview Feedback divides by the total scale.
fields.label: Default Rating Scale

fields.description: Refuse a rating that arrives without a supporting quote from the transcript.
fields.label: Require Evidence Per Skill

fields.description: What to do about a skill the transcript never touches. Escalate leaves it unrated and names it for the interviewer -- the honest default. Rate Zero scores it 0, which drags the average down for something that was simply never asked.
fields.label: Skill With No Evidence

fields.description: Suggest Only writes the assessment as a comment on the Interview and touches no Interview Feedback record. Fill Interviewer Draft writes the ratings and the summary into the interviewer's existing draft Interview Feedback, still unsubmitted. Neither mode ever submits: the result on the record is the interviewer's to confirm.
fields.label: Write Mode

fields.description: Off means a draft that already carries a rating or a written note is left alone -- the agent will not overwrite an interviewer's own work.
fields.label: Overwrite Ratings Already Entered

fields.default: AI-drafted from the interview transcript. Review every rating against the recording before submitting.
fields.description: Prepended to every feedback text the agent writes, so nobody mistakes a draft for a human's assessment.
fields.label: Feedback Note
